response.justification: Despite a strong and diverse software engineering background, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation, cloud platforms, or secure embedded systems as required; their C++ exposure is limited to a brief academic/thesis project and is not reflected in professional roles, which are dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang — making them a poor fit for a role demanding deep C++ architecture and IEC 62443 compliance.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with modern web and distributed systems
Strong track record in open-source contributions and technical mentoring
Proven ability to work across hardware-software boundaries and complex systems
concerns: No professional C++ experience beyond academic/thesis work
Lacks exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) and message brokers like MQTT in production
No demonstrated experience with on-premises industrial automation platforms or IoT protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, etc.)
